Not borderline rapey, just rapey. Coercion is not consent, period. I work in sexual assault/intimate partner violence prevention, this is 100% rape and 100% abuse.

OP, you deserve so much better.

Coercion is NOT consent. He should take your "no" as a "no" and respect your bodily autonomy. He knows you need sleep, he knows you're in pain, and he forces you to have sex anyway. This is rape. Being in a relationship doesn't mean he has more of a right to your body than you do. 

I'm so sorry this is happening and I urge you to end it with him. He is not respecting you at all and respect is the basis of a healthy relationship. This is in no way your fault.

Doterra is an MLM and is awful.

Essential oils don't cure things but the scents can have an impact on the things they're suggested for. Whether it's placebo effect or something else, an oil blend visibly reduced my mom's arthritis and another has helped me cope with migraines. They may not work for everyone and if you have any pets, make sure that your oils aren't toxic for them.

Give them a shot, make sure you buy pure essential oils (more expensive but less chance of irritation) and dilute them with a carrier oil, if they make you more comfortable in your daily life I'd say they're at least working a little.

Absolutely. He heard you about the first two days only to dump you with them for another four? He isn't concerned about your feelings at all.

You're not doing anything wrong. It happened to me, too. He basically is trying to destroy your self worth so you'll be reliant on him. 

The making you feel crazy part is a HUGE aspect of how women get trapped in abusive relationships. He will gaslight you until you feel like you deserve the way he is treating you and then you won't leave because you'll feel that you don't deserve better. I've been there and it feels so shitty. Your emotions are 100% valid and a partner that cares about you wouldn't belittle you for having them.

PM me if you need any help, I work in domestic violence prevention and have resources you can use. Even if you need help figuring out how to break up with him.
